before_live_integration: Replace/resolve source.actual_das_field_id only after matching installed CustomerProfileSchema, related collections and enums
Render synthetic fixtures using the installed renderer; visually inspect character cells, table rows, text baselines and checkbox marks.
Verify every checkbox lands inside official square and every char stays in its cell
Require staff review of any overflow, ambiguous choice, absent required data, and output PDF preview
Retain all 16 original pages and record template hash and corporate snapshot revision.
source_data_ownership: Resolve customer_profile fields only against the approved corporate applicant. Keep primary contact and both board-authorised signatories distinct.
Identify each execution signer and the witness explicitly. Never infer signer identity from contact order.
Use only corporate account-holder tax answers explicitly confirmed for this application. Never substitute an individual signatory’s tax data.
Leave Malaysian tax fields blank when inapplicable. Keep each foreign TIN, missing-TIN reason, and Reason B explanation with its own jurisdiction.

Do not derive an explicit negative from an absent answer. Render related persons, brokers, PEPs, and other-party details only when consistent with their confirmed parent response. Flag inconsistent records for review.
Select the relevant company-owned bank account explicitly for e-payment. Preserve identifiers as strings including leading zeros.
Leave signatures, execution dates, seal, checklist verification and office-only marks for the authorised person.

selection_predicate_convention.checkbox: mark only when verified enum or multiselect contains the printed option after Codex maps enum values
selection_predicate_convention.boolean_choices: mark yes or no only when value explicitly answered, otherwise both blank
selection_predicate_convention.enum_choice: mark exactly one chosen option unless source supports multi-select

renderers.recommended: FPDI plus FPDF/TCPDF or installed equivalent
renderers.coordinate_conversion: If library origin is bottom-left, y_bottom = page_height_pt - y_top - element_height
renderers.reference: Measurements use PyMuPDF visible-page top-left coordinates

runtime_contract.rows_overflow: Never clip. Use a separate sheet or stop for review when records or text exceed printed capacity.
runtime_contract.manual_cells: field positions may be mapped for reference but should_autofill=false is authoritative
